Maria G: Quick question — any 15–25 minute documentaries or short films you love for a tea break? Also looking for mellow background tracks for reading. :tea:
Kevin L: Short doc rec: 'My Grandmother's Garden' — it's 18 min, gentle. Also check Vimeo "short docs" collections.
Samir P: Music: try 'Hammock' (ambient post-rock) and 'Ólafur Arnalds' piano pieces. Great for fuzzy brain time.
Alexa: BBC Sounds has 20-min features that are spot-on. For songs: 'Nils Frahm - Says' is longer but starts mellow.
Luca: If you want tiny, watch 'Bento Box' shorts on YouTube — like TED-length but film-y.
Maria G: @Kevin L any link?
Kevin L: sure — https://vimeo.com/63782901 (short about a community garden).
Samir P: For a one-song pick: 'Hammock — Turn Away and Return' :notes:
Alexa: playlist I made: 'Tea & Quiet (20-40 mins)' — I can share a Spotify link if people want.
Maria G: Please drop it! planning a tea break at 3.
OpsBot: Heads up — Quiet Room B booked 3:00–3:45pm today. :calendar:
Luca: also rec the 15-min 'Tiny Timelines' series — micro docs, very watchable.
Maria G: Perfect. Thanks everyone — adding to the rotation. :clap:
